brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled to relate physicochemical wine measurements to graded sensory quality, whose seven observed integer grades (3-9) form an ordered class outcome, so multiclass classification with quality as the single target is the defensible primary aim; no column is a derived or post-outcome recoding, there are no row keys, and no grouping or chronology fields exist.
brief.repeated_subjects: No subject or specimen identifier repeats; each row is a distinct wine sample
brief.unit: One wine sample (a single physicochemical assay of a wine specimen)
